chart.name: Page faults/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('extra_info.page_faults', rollup='latest').sum(by=['replica_set_name']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).min().publish(label='B')
C = (A).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='E')
F = (A).max().publish(label='F')
G = data('mongodbatlas.process.page_faults', filter=filter('memory_issue_type', 'extra_info')).sum(by=['mongodb_atlas.host.name', 'mongodb_atlas.process.type_name']).publish(label='G', enable=False)
H = (G).min().publish(label='H')
I = (G).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='I')
J = (G).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='J')
K = (G).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='K')
L = (G).max().publish(label='L')

chart.name: Mutations/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('opcounter.insert', rollup='latest').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('opcounter.update', rollup='latest').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A+B).min().publish(label='C')
D = (A+B).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='D')
E = (A+B).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='E')
F = (A+B).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='F')
G = (A+B).max().publish(label='G')
H = data('mongodbatlas.process.db.operations.rate', filter=filter('operation', 'insert')).publish(label='H', enable=False)
I = data('mongodbatlas.process.db.operations.rate', filter=filter('operation', 'update')).publish(label='I', enable=False)
J = (H+I).min().publish(label='J')
K = (H+I).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='K')
L = (H+I).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='L')
M = (H+I).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='M')
N = (H+I).max().publish(label='N')
